usedFor: Productlane holds your customer contacts, and Microsoft Excel stores each one in a table through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Productlane, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact is added to an Excel table you can filter and share.

watchOut: “New Contact” is polling, so rows arrive after a scheduled check, and “Update Row” is a separate step.
